text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Both Helios and Ruby... they've 
conditioned themselves so well. They're 
getting faster! Still—)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ngh, haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Zephyr...! Zephyr, Zephyr! You are—!!)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: She's seriously... gh... so fast...!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I shall become the wind. A wind faster, 
freer than anything, running endlessly to 
wherever it may lead.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Like a certain Umamusume I saw in my 
youth. Or perhaps—even surpassing her.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Breaking free from the shackles of 
distance. Conquering sprints, miles, and 
medium distances alike.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Achieving an unprecedented three-division 
conquest— I shall become the wind running 
boundlessly beyond!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Right here, right now, I will surpass your 
speed!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I see. That is the origin of your 
strength. That's why you're this fast...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Fast... So fast, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing!! You're getting even 
faster, Kei-chan!! The finish line is just 
ahead, keep it up--!!

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, this way, this way! So fast... 
What an amazing kid, really...!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (To be fast.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(To be faster than anyone, faster than 
everyone else.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (..."Fastest of the Era.")

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ngh, yaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
K.S. Miracle in the lead! K.S. Miracle in 
the lead! And across the line she 
goes--she's won it!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
K.S. Miracle takes 1st!! It's K.S. 
Miracle!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by Umamusume boasting blazing 
speed, she takes a glorious victory! 
K.S.Miracle wins it!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Good work today, Miracle-san.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Zephyr. ...Good work to you too, 
Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. ...For now, I cannot 
say anything more than that.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Merely to praise it... racing with you was 
far too exhilarating a tempest—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why... it is so bitterly 
frustrating.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Zephyr...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, but still, please let me say 
just a little bit more from my side."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Zephyr. For racing against me 
today.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for being my classmate... and my 
rival.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hey... Can we shake hands?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"My. Even right after a race... Miracle, 
your hands are quite chilly, aren't they?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my body temperature is pretty low... 
Even like this, I'm warmer than usual, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Still, it's a little 
frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Getting more and more excited. —If only 
things could just heat up like that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As usual, I greet K.S. Miracle in the 
underground tunnel after she returns 
safely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, that look on her face... seemed 
to hold a deeper resolve than ever before.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer. ...Our next target.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: It was the Sprinters Stakes, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Thank you. ...I—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I want to take 1st place.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Without fail. ...I want to become one.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I'll be in your care for training.

text_block_list.name: Man in Red Hat
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Today's Yasuda Kinen was... 
absolutely craaaazy!

text_block_list.name: Man in Red Hat
text_block_list.text:
Btw, isn't the sprint division totally 
packed with stars!? Daiichi Ruby, Daitaku 
Helios! And Bamboo Memory is still giving 
it her all too—

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Blue Scarf
text_block_list.text:
KS Miracle is fully revived! ...Plus, 
Yamanin Zephyr had this amazing 
"Awakened!" vibe today too, it was so 
cool~!

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Blue Scarf
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly, ever since K.S.Miracle made her 
comeback... it feels like the sprint 
division has been getting more and more 
exciting, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Man in Red Hat
text_block_list.text:
Sure, there's been huge news in the 
classic royal road, like Tokai Teio's 
comeback at the Osaka Hai and Mihono 
Bourbon winning the Double Crown, but 
still!

text_block_list.name: Man in Red Hat
text_block_list.text:
The sprint division ain't losing either, 
right?! An acquaintance of mine was blown 
away watching the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, 
and apparently came to watch today's race 
too!!

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Blue Scarf
text_block_list.text:
Right, right, I totally get it!! Come 
autumn, the new generation will rise up, 
and things might get even crazier... 
excited yet?!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Aah!! I'm looking forward to it so much~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A pure and unyielding pursuit of absolute 
speed—the world of sprint Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As those captivated by her steadily grew 
more fervent—the summer of K.S. Miracle's 
third year began.
